verdict.rationale: EFTPS lets users schedule tax payments up to 365 days ahead. Those payments settle unattended on the chosen date, with email notifications and easy change/cancel, so there is a narrow form of background execution. There is no general automation or workflow capability: no documented API or OpenAPI spec, and the only software channel is desktop Batch Provider Software. Missing for 10: configurable automation rules or recurring triggers, programmatic/API-driven automation, agent-oriented machine interfaces, and any independent corroboration of unattended operation.
